messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick logistics note 2: Lina Park is dropping off an easel + framed crate tomorrow at ~10:30 for an 11:00 mini-demo. Can someone cover the desk and snag a dolly? Also tag crate FRAGILE and reserve the window corner table.

sam: I can cover the desk 10:2010:50. Ill bring a folding dolly from locker. :thumbsup:

jen: Will print a guest badge and a Wi-Fi card. What should the badge say ("Guest of Design" vs "Artist Demo")?

marta (People Ops): "Artist Demo" pls. Accessibility note: Lina requested step-free access and a low stool.

alejandro: If the crate needs short-term storage, Locker A3 is our framed-art spot. Ill label it and mark fragile.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration: Lina Park ID uploaded, vehicle plate ABC-321. Arrival ETA: 10:45-11:00.

sam: Copy. Will not leave frames in the corridor. Moving crate to A3 after check-in. Pinged @facilities for extra straps.

facilities: Dolly + moving straps will be at lobby by 10:15. Well also place a mat by the door for the crate.

lina (guest): Thanks all! Ill aim for 10:45 with one large framed piece (24x36) and a small crate. Looking forward to the demo see you at 11. :)
